_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Mary Prichard Agnetti (1870-1948): Fogazzaro's The Patriot (Piccolo mondo antico, 1906) and Leila (1911); from archive.org, The Saint (1906) and The Sinner (1907). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 32); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

agnetti-fogazzaro-the-saint.scan_edition: G. P. Putnam's Sons, New York and London, 1908: the November 1908 reprint of the August 1906 first printing (Google scan); introduction by William Roscoe Thayer

agnetti-fogazzaro-the-sinner.scan_edition: G. P. Putnam's Sons, New York and London, copyright 1907

_pending.agnetti-papini-story-of-christ: Papini's The Story of Christ (Hodder and Stoughton, 'third edition'; in.ernet.dli.2015.220638). The title page names her but prints no year; the translation is 1923. Shelve once a dated pre-1931 printing is found.
